business_problem: DXC's security operations center had to protect a global enterprise with more than one million devices, while analysts were spending up to 80% of their time reviewing false positives and performing routine investigations instead of focusing on threat hunting and complex cases.
solution_summary: DXC deployed DXC Agentic SOC, powered by 7AI, across its own global security environment to automate first-line SOC investigations at enterprise scale. Security alerts generated across more than one million devices are fed into the platform, where autonomous agents investigate them in parallel instead of sending every repeatable case to analysts. The system uses AI reasoning to execute routine investigation work, correlate evidence from across DXC's security environment, and produce clear, evidence-based findings for human review. DXC's cybersecurity teams review those investigations in production and use the feedback to improve agent capabilities and investigation strategies over time. The source does not disclose the persistent storage tier, but it does describe an optional integration with DXC OASIS to connect cyber and IT operations, provide real-time visibility across the wider IT estate, and shorten the path from threat detection to remediation.

data_flow: Security alerts from DXC's global environment of more than one million devices enter DXC Agentic SOC, where 7AI-powered autonomous agents investigate high-volume cases in parallel, correlate evidence across the security environment, and return evidence-based findings and audit-ready documentation to analysts. When connected, DXC OASIS extends that output into a wider IT operations view to accelerate remediation.
business_outcome: DXC automated most repeatable alert investigations, reduced investigation time, improved remediation accuracy, saved analyst hours, produced audit-ready incident documentation, and freed analysts to focus on higher-value work such as threat hunting and intelligence.
